crossRefs.note: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.
Yahweh said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,
I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”
The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one…
God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.
Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are…
What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all…
Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake…
and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace…
how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
Behold, I have only found this: that God made man upright; but they search for many schemes.”
This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all: yes also, the heart of the sons of…
The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”
Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his…
For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy…
Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?

translations.web: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great upon the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was altogether evil all the time.
translations.kjv: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
translations.asv: And Jehovah saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
